items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: Well, Ray Nance, you know, he would get up, he would do his dance, he would sing, you know.

ctx.x: And he had something to deviate his mind from the drugs to dancing. And he got his exercise.

And, you know, you take the Charlie Parkers and the Fats Navarros and the guys like that, they sat down and they played. Well, Ray Nance, you know, he would get up, he would do his dance, he would sing, you know.
But another thing about him, you never saw him nodding off. Not like --
